1935, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOCK NO. 5.
Blank Page
Jan. 29 Mrs. Gert. Heenan - 48 - of Pontiac Enrolled in May 1930 - eyeritus in agony never went back to Dr. Now ever since O.K.
Mrs. Jones - picture etc.
John Lou - 32 - "Articular Rhumatism started in
Eileen Donahue - 21 - graduate in Comer'l looking for position -asks for prayers.
Mrs. Kloka - 40 - broke arm ....
Frances Mooney - 9 - diabetis, hopeless in
30 Mrs. Anna Slamka - about 50 - lost leg by cancer ten yrs. ago; since then a convert - now seems to be going to stomach. Daughter in Con- vent while still n.c.
Bernard Susewitz - 15 - Enrolled a year ago for Epil. fits. Father was lutheran - strict ... now is preparing a surprise for wife- which she has found out First Com. on his 36th birth-day (March 17)
Mrs. Wm. White - 39 - trying for invalid's pension .. .. artificial rectum.
Mrs. E. Van Loo - 45 - four children - sorosis liver.
Blank Page.
Page 299 Page 300 Jan. 30 Wm. Debus - blood poison - fears other operation To-day Peter Hitzel - 62 - lost property & sight - hopes to recover both. 30 Mrs. Lizetta Wnedling - 34 - infected eye - doctoring so far to little efect.
Mrs. Blum - 56 - son-in-law owes - $40 owing .....
Mrs. Sales - family difficulties - prayers that God direct and give her patience.
31 Mrs. Plagens - only 40 - (8 of 12 living) large family sister-in-law of Bp. P. - kidney & Heart - said to be hopeless case - Enrolled To-day.
